status: freeze and push before any evaluation sampling
owner: Quantyra Space under Dan's research direction
user_and_decision: A relativistic simulation researcher checks a simulator's nominated normalized marked interval volume. Report accept if the confidence set lies inside the nominated tolerance band, reject if disjoint, unresolved otherwise; an empty set is a model alarm.
geometry: 1+1 null square, rho=1+epsilon*(2u-1)*(2v-1), fixed anchors (0,0),(1/2,1/2), positive conformal metric and strict directed chronology. All epsilons are within the already accepted [0,1/2] family in original K.
input_contract: Both methods receive the same full Boolean chronological relation, fixed anchor roles, retained n and R only. No coordinates, epsilon, detector pattern/values, rejected count or generated count. Sample labels carry no information.
withholding: Freeze every source, scenario and threshold before sampling. The known phase runs first. Withheld configurations and all latent variables are evaluator-only inputs and are never fitted or passed to an estimator. This is prespecified synthetic holdout, not an externally blinded dataset. No tuning between phases.
detectors: Piecewise constant on the 4x4 square grid, weights 1 or 1/R. inside_low is low on the lower-left 2x2 cells; inside_high is high there; checker4 is low on even i+j; stripes4 is low on even i. uniform is one everywhere. Extend outside the square by one. These are assumed sensitivity ranges, not measured instrument efficiencies.
sampling: NumPy PCG64, independent uniform proposal coordinates, geometry acceptance rho/1.5, then independent detector acceptance. Stop at first n retained events. Failure to obtain n within 64*n proposals fails the run; never resample an unfavorable trial. Float simulation is a reproducibility diagnostic; exact-law calculations refer to the continuous mathematical model.
seed_construction: SeedSequence([seed,phase_index,epsilon_index,ratio_index,pattern_index,size_index,replicate]); phase known=0, withheld=1. Each trial independently seeded.
calibration_reuse: Read only the fixed exact-binomial endpoint table for n=0,64,256,1024 at denominator 65536. Reverify every integer-tail certificate. Reuse no prior geometry sample or performance result; preserve original files.
method_definition: Quantyra extracts marked flags, uses the existing marked_count and retention_interval with the certified binomial table. The reference independently counts the marked relation and applies the binary inverse-weight ratio formulas to the same certificate. All reports intersect [1/8,3/8]. known_range uses only that range; ignore_bias omits the retention transform and is not a valid competitor when R>1.
stronger_alternatives: Fay 2010 RJ-2010-008 identifies sharper exact methods; CP is not globally optimal. README gives the sufficient stopping argument. Blaker endpoints are not numerically evaluated. A positive advance would require evaluating stronger applicable alternatives.
primary_metrics: For every stratum and every possible count, compute continuous-model binomial coverage, mean width, probability of nonempty width<=1/10, empty probability, midpoint absolute error (empty fallback 1/4), and correct/incorrect decisive probabilities for each nominated volume. Empty alarms count as incorrect for these admitted models. Exact integer atom weights, no Monte Carlo coverage inference or quadrature.
metric_precision: Coverage and decision probabilities are exact rational values. Expected widths and midpoint errors are outward enclosures using per-count rounding at denominator 10^10; enclosure width <=10^-10.
artifact_format: Strata, trials and coordinate witnesses are UTF-8 JSON in deterministic gzip files; summaries, controls and source manifests are plain JSON.
simulation_metrics: All 8448 trials retain counts, proposals, relation/coordinate SHA256 and method times. Keep coordinates for the first replicate of each stratum for independent replay. Check count equals coordinate membership for every trial. For every first replicate, compare the full relation with t/x Lorentz chronology, transpose invariance and a deterministic reverse relabeling.
sampling_diagnostic: Across 132 strata compare the aggregate observed membership rate with the exact retained probability. Family failure budget .01; use Hoeffding radius sqrt(log(2*132/.01)/(2*n*64)), rounded upward to a 10^-9 grid. A failure is investigated, not retuned away. This diagnostic does not certify a floating sampler.
zero_sample_control: For all four R values, both valid methods on the two-anchor order return [1/8,3/8]. Separate from positive-size strata.

advance_gate.validity: All endpoint certificates, exact coverage>=19/20 for valid methods, exact wrong-decision probabilities<=1/20, geometry/count/relabel checks and negative controls pass. Resource and sampling-diagnostic gates also pass.
advance_gate.absolute_utility: In every withheld stratum at n=1024,R<=5/4, probability of nonempty width<=1/10 >=4/5, and mean correct-decisive probability across both nominated volumes >=4/5.
advance_gate.additionality: In every same withheld gate stratum, either mean width <=9/10 of the established counterpart's mean width with no lower correct-decision probability, or correct-decisive probability improves by >=1/20 with no larger mean width. No worse wrong-decision probability. Cost remains within the same declared ceiling. Identical reports fail additionality.
advance_gate.decision: Advance to an operational observation simulator only if validity, absolute utility and additionality all pass. Otherwise park this candidate's operational application route, distinguish invalid execution from valid comparative no-go, and retain useful scientific verification. Do not claim universal application impossibility. No revised candidate in S044 is authorized by a failed comparison alone.

cost_accounting: Measure fresh certificate verification, exact-law evaluation, sampling, relation construction and each report method separately. The shared precomputed calibration bank has equal access for both methods; historical generation cost is not a measured new cost. Tracemalloc excludes untraced native/process memory. No dollar-cost or runtime-superiority claim.
source_control: Require clean matching local/remote main before execution. Record exact committed source identities and all pre-existing tracked file hashes; preserve them after execution. New attempt directory only; retain failures. No Lean invocation or changes to accepted theorem sources, manuscripts or prior experiments.
conditional_stages: Only a passing advance gate can justify an operational observation simulator. Existing-data/controlled-measurement and resource-management chains remain conditional on that model and comparison. No partner contact, data collection, deployment or carrying-capacity score upgrade follows from this simulation.
